title: Gene expression datasets, clinical validation data, and analytical scripts for HDAC6/XK as novel oxidative stress-related diagnostic biomarkers in acute myocardial infarction
author: han xu
license_note: figshare article detail endpoint license.name: CC BY 4.0

steps.title: Document dataset components
steps.instruction: This dataset supports the research article "Identification of HDAC6 and XK as a novel gene signature associated with oxidative stress for early diagnosis of acute myocardial infarction". The data package includes three core components: (

Processed gene expression data from GEO datasets GSE29111 and GSE97320 (platform: GPL570), including normalized expression matrices, differentially expressed genes (DEGs) lists, and weighted gene co-expression network analysis (WGCNA) module genes; (

steps.title: Verify RT-qPCR data for HDAC6, XK, GAPDH
steps.instruction: Clinical validation data: raw Ct values of quantitative real-time PCR (RT-qPCR) for HDAC6, XK, and reference gene GAPDH in peripheral blood samples from 10 acute myocardial infarction (AMI) patients and 10 non-AMI controls (matched for age and sex), along with melting curve verification images and sample information sheets; (

steps.title: Write analytical scripts
steps.instruction: Analytical scripts: R code for differential expression analysis (limma), WGCNA, protein-protein interaction (PPI) network construction, machine learning screening (random forest, LASSO regression, support vector machine), Gene Ontology (GO) enrichment, Gene Set Enrichment Analysis (GSEA), and ROC curve analysis.
